scenarios.title: Al forno
scenarios.setting: A small bakery on a weekday morning, a short queue behind the learner.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the person behind the counter.
scenarios.goal: Comprare del pane e un caffè.
scenarios.goalEn: Buy some bread and a coffee.

beats.en: Say how much bread you want.

beats.text: Chiedere che tipi di pane ci sono.
beats.en: Ask what kinds of bread there are.
Say how you take your coffee.

beats.text: Dire se è da consumare qui o da portare via.
beats.en: Say whether it's to have here or to take away.

beats.text: Chiedere se puoi pagare con la carta.
beats.en: Ask if you can pay by card.

scenarios.title: Un tavolo per due
scenarios.setting: A busy café at lunchtime; some tables are free.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the waiter.
scenarios.goal: Avere un tavolo e ordinare.
scenarios.goalEn: Get a table and order something.

beats.en: Ask for a table for two.

beats.text: Chiedere un posto vicino alla finestra o fuori.
beats.en: Ask for a seat by the window or outside.

beats.text: Dire se pagate insieme o separati.
beats.en: Say whether you're paying separately or together.

scenarios.title: Nuovi vicini
scenarios.setting: In the stairwell of an apartment block; the learner has just moved in.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the neighbour from the flat below.
scenarios.goal: Presentarti e scoprire qualcosa sul quartiere.
scenarios.goalEn: Introduce yourself and learn about the area.

beats.en: Say which flat you live in.
Say what you do for a living.

beats.text: Chiedere della spazzatura o della lavanderia.
beats.en: Ask about the bins or the laundry room.

beats.text: Dire che sei contento di conoscerlo.
beats.en: Say you're pleased to meet them.

scenarios.title: Comprare un biglietto
scenarios.setting: A ticket counter at a regional station, mid-morning.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the clerk at the counter.
scenarios.goal: Comprare un biglietto per Firenze.
scenarios.goalEn: Buy a ticket to Florence.

beats.text: Dire che ti serve un biglietto.

beats.en: Say where you want to go.
Say when you want to travel.
Ask if you have to change trains.

beats.text: Scegliere solo andata o andata e ritorno.

scenarios.title: Chiamare il medico di base
scenarios.setting: On the phone to the family doctor's surgery on a Monday morning.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the receptionist.
scenarios.goal: Avere un appuntamento.
scenarios.goalEn: Get an appointment.

beats.text: Dire che ti serve un appuntamento.

beats.en: Say how long you've been ill.

beats.text: Dire se sei già paziente dello studio.
beats.en: Say whether you're already a patient.

scenarios.title: Il primo giorno
scenarios.setting: A small office on the learner's first morning.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a friendly colleague.
scenarios.goal: Presentarti e capire dove sono le cose.
scenarios.goalEn: Introduce yourself and find out where things are.

beats.text: Dire che oggi è il tuo primo giorno.
Dire qual è il tuo ruolo.

beats.en: Ask if you can have lunch together.

scenarios.title: Arriva un ospite
scenarios.setting: At the learner's front door; a friend has arrived for coffee.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the friend visiting.
scenarios.goal: Far entrare l'amico e offrirgli qualcosa.
scenarios.goalEn: Welcome the guest in and offer something.

beats.en: Open the door and say hello.

beats.text: Dire che sei contento che sia venuto.

beats.en: Offer to hang up their coat.

beats.text: Offrire un caffè o un tè.
Chiedere se vuole latte e zucchero.

scenarios.title: Arrivare in albergo
scenarios.setting: A small hotel reception in the early evening.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the receptionist.
scenarios.goal: Fare il check-in e chiedere della colazione.
scenarios.goalEn: Check in and ask about breakfast.

beats.text: Fare lo spelling del tuo nome.

beats.en: Say how many nights you're staying.

scenarios.title: Cambiare senza scontrino
scenarios.setting: A clothes shop on a Saturday; the learner wants to exchange a jumper.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the shop assistant, polite but bound by the rules.
scenarios.goal: Cambiare il maglione anche senza scontrino.
scenarios.goalEn: Exchange the jumper although the receipt is missing.

beats.text: Dire che vuoi cambiare un articolo.
beats.en: Say you'd like to exchange something.
Give the reason for the exchange.

beats.text: Dire che non hai lo scontrino.
beats.en: Say that you don't have the receipt.

beats.text: Chiedere se si può fare lo stesso.

beats.en: Ask how long the credit note is valid.

scenarios.title: Darsi malato
scenarios.setting: On the phone to the office at eight in the morning.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the learner's team lead, understanding but busy.
scenarios.goal: Avvisare che stai male e passare le cose urgenti.
scenarios.goalEn: Call in sick and hand over the essentials.

beats.text: Salutare e dire il tuo nome.
beats.en: Say hello and give your name.

beats.text: Dire che oggi non puoi venire.
beats.en: Say you can't come in today.
Say whether you're going to the doctor.
Explain how long it might take.

beats.text: Chiedere se serve il certificato medico.
beats.en: Ask whether you need a doctor's certificate.

beats.text: Dire qual è il compito più importante.

beats.en: Say who can take it over.
Ask for a meeting to be cancelled.

beats.text: Dire se sei raggiungibile al cellulare.
beats.en: Say whether you can be reached by phone.
Promise to get in touch tomorrow.

beats.text: Ringraziare per gli auguri di guarigione.

scenarios.title: C'è un errore
scenarios.setting: A restaurant in the evening; the dish that arrived is not what was ordered.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the waiter, apologetic.
scenarios.goal: Segnalare con garbo il piatto sbagliato.
scenarios.goalEn: Politely point out the wrong dish.

beats.text: Dire con gentilezza che c'è un problema.

beats.en: Say why you can't eat it.
Ask for it to be replaced.
Ask how long it will take.

beats.text: Dire che gli altri stanno già mangiando.
beats.en: Say that the others are already eating.

beats.text: Dire se il nuovo piatto è giusto.
beats.en: Say whether the new dish is right.

scenarios.title: Treno perso
scenarios.setting: A main station; the learner's connection has just left.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a staff member at the information desk.
scenarios.goal: Trovare un'altra coincidenza.
scenarios.goalEn: Find a new connection.

beats.en: Ask if you have to change.

beats.text: Chiedere se il biglietto è ancora valido.
beats.en: Ask whether your ticket is still valid.

beats.text: Chiedere se serve la prenotazione del posto.
beats.en: Ask whether you need a seat reservation.

scenarios.title: Alla festa di compleanno
scenarios.setting: A flat party; the learner knows only the host.
scenarios.partner: Mural is another guest, friendly and curious.
scenarios.goal: Attaccare discorso e trovare qualcosa in comune.
scenarios.goalEn: Get talking and find something in common.

beats.en: Say how you know the host.
Ask how they know the host.

scenarios.title: Ritirare un pacco
scenarios.setting: A post office counter at lunchtime; the learner has a missed-delivery slip.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the clerk.
scenarios.goal: Ritirare il pacco anche senza documento originale.
scenarios.goalEn: Collect the parcel even without your original ID.

beats.text: Dire che devi ritirare un pacco.
beats.en: Say you'd like to collect a parcel.

beats.text: Dire che hai l'avviso di giacenza.
beats.en: Say you have the missed-delivery slip.

beats.text: Fare lo spelling del tuo nome.
Spiegare il problema con il documento.
beats.en: Explain the problem with your ID.

beats.text: Dire cosa hai con te al suo posto.
beats.en: Say what you have with you instead.
Ask whether a copy is enough.

beats.text: Chiedere per quanto resta qui il pacco.
beats.en: Ask how long the parcel stays here.

beats.text: Chiedere se può ritirarlo un'altra persona.
beats.en: Ask whether someone else can collect it.
Ask about a letter of authorisation.

scenarios.title: Il riscaldamento è rotto
scenarios.setting: On the phone to the landlord in November.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the landlord, a little slow to act.
scenarios.goal: Concordare una riparazione.
scenarios.goalEn: Arrange a repair.

beats.text: Salutare e dire il tuo nome.
beats.en: Say hello and give your name.

beats.text: Dire che il riscaldamento non funziona.

beats.en: Say how long it's been like this.

beats.text: Dire quanto fa freddo in casa.
beats.en: Say how cold the flat is.

scenarios.title: Organizzare una gita
scenarios.setting: A hotel lobby; the learner wants to see something nearby.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the receptionist with local knowledge.
scenarios.goal: Organizzare una gita per domani.
scenarios.goalEn: Plan a trip for tomorrow.

beats.text: Dire che domani vuoi fare una gita.
beats.en: Say you'd like a day out tomorrow.
Ask what there is to see there.
Ask whether you need to book anything.

scenarios.title: Al corso di lingua
scenarios.setting: The first evening of an adult Italian course.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the teacher welcoming a new student.
scenarios.goal: Iscriverti e chiarire il tuo livello.
scenarios.goalEn: Sign up and sort out your level.

beats.en: Say how long you've been learning Italian.

beats.text: Chiedere se c'è un test d'ingresso.
beats.en: Ask if there's a placement test.

scenarios.title: Chiedere un aumento
scenarios.setting: A one-to-one with the manager, scheduled by the learner.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the manager, fair but non-committal.
scenarios.goal: Sollevare la questione dello stipendio e concordare il prossimo passo.
scenarios.goalEn: Raise the subject of a pay rise and agree a next step.

beats.en: Greet them and thank them for their time.
Say how long you've been there.

beats.text: Citare i nuovi compiti che hai preso.
beats.en: Mention new tasks you've taken on.

beats.text: Dire una cifra o una forbice.
beats.en: Name a figure or a range.
Ask what the objection means exactly.
Raise an alternative to a raise.

beats.text: Chiedere cosa devi fare per ottenerlo.
beats.en: Ask what you'd need to do for it.
Ask when a decision will be made.
Agree on a concrete next step.

scenarios.title: Spostare una scadenza
scenarios.setting: A video call with a colleague whose work depends on the learner's.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the colleague, under pressure themselves.
scenarios.goal: Spiegare il ritardo e fissare una nuova scadenza.
scenarios.goalEn: Explain a delay and agree a new deadline.

beats.en: Ask if they have a moment.
Give the reason for the delay.

beats.text: Chiedere che conseguenze ha per lui.
Mostrare comprensione per la sua pressione.
Chiedere cosa gli serve per primo.

beats.en: Ask who needs to be told.

scenarios.title: All'anagrafe
scenarios.setting: The town hall registry office; the learner is registering a new address.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the official, correct and procedural.
scenarios.goal: Fare il cambio di residenza anche se manca un documento.
scenarios.goalEn: Change your registered address even though a document is missing.

beats.en: Give the date you moved in.
Say which documents you have with you.
Ask whether you can hand it in later.

beats.text: Chiedere se si può mandare per mail.
Chiedere cosa succede se non la rispetti.
beats.en: Ask what happens if you miss it.

beats.text: Chiedere se serve un nuovo appuntamento.
beats.en: Ask whether you need a new appointment.

scenarios.title: Rifiutare un invito
scenarios.setting: A phone call to a good friend two days before their party.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the friend, disappointed but reasonable.
scenarios.goal: Dire di no con garbo senza rovinare l'amicizia.
scenarios.goalEn: Decline kindly without straining the friendship.

beats.text: Dire che ti ha fatto piacere.
beats.en: Say you were pleased to be asked.

beats.text: Mostrare che l'amicizia conta per te.
beats.en: Show that the friendship matters to you.

beats.text: Offrirti di aiutare con i preparativi.

beats.en: Send your regards to the guests.

scenarios.title: Reclamare per la camera
scenarios.setting: A hotel reception; the room is noisy and overlooks building work.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the receptionist, keen to keep the guest.
scenarios.goal: Ottenere un'altra camera o un rimborso.
scenarios.goalEn: Get another room or some compensation.

beats.text: Dire nome e numero di camera.
beats.en: Give your name and room number.
Say that you have a problem.
Say since when it's been noisy.
Ask whether the building work was known.
Ask for details about the other room.

scenarios.title: Riparare il cellulare
scenarios.setting: A repair shop; the screen is cracked and the phone is just out of warranty.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the technician.
scenarios.goal: Chiarire costo e tempi e decidere.
scenarios.goalEn: Find out cost and time, then decide.

beats.text: Rispondere a quello che ti dicono sulla garanzia.
beats.en: Respond to the answer about the warranty.
Ask whether the repair is worth it.

scenarios.title: Dal dentista
scenarios.setting: A dental surgery; the learner has had pain for a week.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the dentist.
scenarios.goal: Descrivere i disturbi e capire la cura.
scenarios.goalEn: Describe the trouble and understand the plan.

beats.text: Chiedere cosa copre il servizio sanitario.

beats.en: Ask what to watch out for afterwards.

scenarios.title: Chiacchierare in treno
scenarios.setting: A long regional train; the learner shares a table with a stranger.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a talkative fellow passenger.
scenarios.goal: Fare una vera conversazione e chiuderla con garbo.
scenarios.goalEn: Hold a real conversation and end it politely.

beats.text: Chiedere se il posto è libero.
beats.en: Ask whether the seat is free.
Ask a question about the region.

scenarios.title: Critiche nel gruppo
scenarios.setting: A meeting room after a project went badly; the learner must give difficult feedback.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the colleague receiving the feedback, initially defensive.
scenarios.goal: Fare una critica oggettiva e andare avanti insieme.
scenarios.goalEn: Give criticism objectively and move forward together.

beats.en: State the purpose of the talk.

beats.text: Chiedere il suo punto di vista.
Rispondere con calma alla sua difensiva.

beats.en: Bring it back to the point.
Make a proposal of your own.

beats.text: Fissare una data per fare il punto.
beats.en: Set a date to review progress.

scenarios.title: Trattare l'offerta
scenarios.setting: A final interview; the offer is slightly below expectation.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the hiring manager with a budget to defend.
scenarios.goal: Trattare l'offerta senza mettere a rischio il posto.
scenarios.goalEn: Negotiate the offer without risking the job.

beats.text: Dire cosa ti attira del ruolo.
beats.en: Say what attracts you to the role.

beats.text: Dire che l'offerta è sotto le tue aspettative.
beats.en: Say the offer is below your expectations.
Ask how much room there is.

beats.text: Parlare di smart working o ferie.
Proporre una revisione dopo il periodo di prova.

scenarios.title: Contestare una bolletta
scenarios.setting: A phone call to an energy supplier about a sharply higher bill.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a call-centre agent following a script.
scenarios.goal: Far verificare la bolletta e ottenere un impegno.
scenarios.goalEn: Get the bill reviewed and obtain a commitment.

beats.text: Dire che i consumi non sono cambiati.
Chiedere se la lettura è stimata.
beats.en: Ask whether the reading was estimated.

beats.text: Chiedere di un aumento delle tariffe.
Chiedere se puoi sospendere il pagamento.
beats.en: Ask whether you can suspend payment.

beats.text: Chiedere di parlare con un responsabile.
beats.en: Ask to speak to someone responsible.
Sum up the call and end it.

scenarios.title: Un tema scottante a cena
scenarios.setting: A dinner party where another guest raises a touchy political subject.
scenarios.partner: Mural is that guest, opinionated but not hostile.
scenarios.goal: Dissentire con garbo senza rovinare la serata.
scenarios.goalEn: Disagree politely without spoiling the evening.

beats.text: Riassumere il punto di vista dell'ospite.
Fare una domanda a tua volta.
Reagire con calma a una provocazione.
Mostrare rispetto per la sua opinione.

beats.en: Lead into a change of topic.

beats.text: Aprire il nuovo tema con una domanda.
beats.en: Open the new topic with a question.

beats.text: Fare un complimento al padrone di casa.

scenarios.title: Volo cancellato
scenarios.setting: An airline desk after a cancellation; a long queue and few options.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the airline agent, harried.
scenarios.goal: Ottenere un altro volo e il risarcimento.
scenarios.goalEn: Sort out rebooking and compensation.

beats.en: Say why you need to get there urgently.
Ask about the train as an alternative.

beats.text: Parlare dei tuoi diritti di passeggero.

scenarios.title: Rumore dai vicini
scenarios.setting: At the neighbour's door after several late, loud nights.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the neighbour, surprised and a bit defensive.
scenarios.goal: Parlare del problema e trovare un accordo.
scenarios.goalEn: Raise the problem and reach an agreement.

beats.text: Chiedere se è un buon momento.
beats.en: Ask if now is a good time.
Come to the reason you're here.

beats.text: Offrirti di parlarne direttamente in caso di problemi.
beats.en: Offer to talk directly again if there's a problem.

scenarios.title: Rifiutare un incarico
scenarios.setting: The manager asks the learner to take on a fourth project.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the manager, used to saying yes to everything.
scenarios.goal: Dire di no e chiarire le priorità.
scenarios.goalEn: Say no and clarify priorities.

beats.en: Ask for details about the project.

beats.text: Descrivere il tuo carico di lavoro.

scenarios.title: Networking in fiera
scenarios.setting: A busy trade-fair stand; the learner wants a useful contact.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a potential business contact with little time.
scenarios.goal: Suscitare interesse e fissare un incontro.
scenarios.goalEn: Spark interest and secure a follow-up.

beats.text: Dire in una frase cosa offri.
beats.en: State the benefit in one sentence.
Respond to their lack of time.

beats.text: Chiedere chi è la persona giusta.
beats.en: Ask who the right contact is.
Wish them a good day at the fair.

scenarios.title: Mediare un conflitto
scenarios.setting: Two colleagues have stopped co-operating; the learner chairs the clearing session.
scenarios.partner: Mural plays the more entrenched of the two colleagues.
scenarios.goal: Sbloccare la situazione e arrivare a un accordo solido.
scenarios.goalEn: Unlock the standoff and reach a workable agreement.

beats.text: Presentare il tuo ruolo come neutrale.

beats.en: State the aim of the meeting.

beats.text: Invitare a esporre il primo punto di vista.
beats.en: Invite the first point of view.

beats.text: Parlare delle emozioni dietro le accuse.
beats.en: Address the feelings behind the accusations.
Bring in the other point of view.

beats.text: Far emergere gli interessi dietro le posizioni.
beats.en: Draw out the interests behind positions.
Name the core of the conflict.

scenarios.title: Dare una brutta notizia
scenarios.setting: The learner must tell a long-standing supplier the contract will not be renewed.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the supplier's owner, who expected a renewal.
scenarios.goal: Comunicare la decisione con chiarezza e dignità.
scenarios.goalEn: Deliver the decision clearly and with dignity.

beats.text: Salutare e ringraziare per essere venuto.
beats.en: Greet them and thank them for coming.
State the reason for the meeting.

beats.text: Dire che la decisione è definitiva.
beats.en: Make clear the decision is final.

beats.text: Chiedere cosa significa per la sua azienda.
beats.en: Ask what the decision means for their business.

beats.text: Respingere con garbo un tentativo di farti cambiare idea.
beats.en: Kindly turn down an attempt to change your mind.

beats.text: Spiegare i tempi della chiusura del rapporto.
beats.en: Explain the timeline for winding down.

beats.text: Rispondere sulla possibilità di collaborare in futuro.
beats.en: Respond to the question of working together later.

scenarios.title: Fare ricorso
scenarios.setting: An appointment at an authority to contest a formal decision.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the case officer, procedurally correct.
scenarios.goal: Motivare il ricorso e chiarire la procedura.
scenarios.goalEn: Justify the objection and clarify the procedure.

beats.en: State the purpose of the appointment.

beats.text: Mettere in dubbio una formulazione del provvedimento.
beats.en: Question a wording in the decision.
Ask for a rule to be explained.

beats.text: Chiedere se il ricorso sospende il provvedimento.
beats.en: Ask whether the objection suspends the decision.

beats.text: Riformulare quello che dice il funzionario.

scenarios.title: Fare un discorso
scenarios.setting: A colleague's leaving do; the learner has been asked to say a few words.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a guest who chats with the learner before and after.
scenarios.goal: Preparare e fare un discorso breve e caloroso.
scenarios.goalEn: Prepare and give a short, warm speech.

beats.text: Dire che ti hanno chiesto di dire due parole.
beats.en: Say you've been asked to give a speech.

beats.text: Fare gli auguri per il futuro.
beats.en: Give good wishes for the future.

beats.text: Rispondere con modestia a un complimento.

beats.en: Talk about how it went down.
Steer the talk to the evening.

scenarios.title: Un viaggio con idee diverse
scenarios.titleEn: Planning a trip with a clash
scenarios.setting: Two friends plan a shared holiday but want very different things.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the friend who wants a packed itinerary.
scenarios.goal: Trovare un compromesso che vada bene a tutti e due.
scenarios.goalEn: Find a compromise both are happy with.

beats.text: Raccogliere i desideri di tutti e due.
Spiegare il tuo bisogno di riposo.
Nominare una cosa irrinunciabile e una facoltativa.
beats.en: Name one must-have and one nice-to-have.

beats.text: Proporre di fare alcune cose separati.

scenarios.title: Presentare un progetto
scenarios.setting: A steering meeting; the learner presents results and takes hard questions.
scenarios.partner: Mural is a sceptical stakeholder.
scenarios.goal: Difendere i risultati e reggere le domande difficili.
scenarios.goalEn: Defend the results and handle the questions.

beats.text: Mettere in evidenza un dato chiave.

beats.en: Ask for a question to be clarified.

scenarios.title: Fare le condoglianze
scenarios.setting: A colleague has lost a parent and is back at work.
scenarios.partner: Mural is that colleague, quiet and composed.
scenarios.goal: Mostrare vicinanza senza essere invadente.
scenarios.goalEn: Show sympathy without intruding.

beats.text: Chiedere se è un buon momento.
beats.en: Ask if it's a good moment.

beats.text: Fargli capire che non deve per forza parlare.
beats.en: Signal they don't have to talk.

beats.text: Rispondere con empatia a quello che racconta.
beats.en: Respond with empathy to what they share.

beats.text: Accennare con delicatezza a un'esperienza tua.

beats.en: Ask about the parent who died.

beats.text: Dire che hai pensato a lui.
beats.en: Say you've been thinking of them.

beats.text: Chiedere com'è il rientro al lavoro.
beats.en: Ask how coming back to work is going.

beats.text: Dire che il lutto ha bisogno di tempo.
Passare alla quotidianità se lo desidera.
beats.en: Move to everyday things if they want.
Offer to be there any time.
Say goodbye with a warm word.

scenarios.title: Trattare l'aumento dell'affitto
scenarios.setting: The landlord has announced a steep increase; the learner wants it reduced.
scenarios.partner: Mural is the landlord, citing the market.
scenarios.goal: Ridurre o ammorbidire l'aumento.
scenarios.goalEn: Reduce or soften the increase.

beats.en: Greet them and thank them for the meeting.

beats.text: Confermare di aver ricevuto la lettera.

beats.en: Say how long you've lived there.
Stress that you want to stay.
Question the size of the increase.

beats.text: Citare gli accordi territoriali sugli affitti.

beats.en: Raise the condition of the flat.

beats.text: Ricordare che sei un inquilino puntuale.
beats.en: Point to your reliability as a tenant.

beats.text: Legare una concessione a delle condizioni.

beats.en: Ask how much room there is.
